title: Eating and drinking
about: Collocations for talking about food and eating: types of food (junk food, fresh produce, ready meals, food poisoning) and meals, drinks and appetite (a light meal, a hearty breakfast, a refreshing drink, spoil your appetite, a set menu).

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Українське «кухня» має два значення. Кімната — kitchen. Їжа країни чи народу — food, cooking або cuisine /kwɪˈziːn/: I love Italian food, French cuisine is famous all over the world. Italian kitchen у цьому значенні не кажуть. Їжа різних країн — international food / cuisine, а не world-wide. A Chinese / Mexican / French meal — конкретна їжа, яку ти їси в ресторані: We went out for a Mexican meal. У британській розмовній мові a Chinese / an Indian — ще й їжа на винос: Shall we get a Chinese tonight?

rows: French kitchen is famous for its sauces.
French cooking is famous for its sauces.
ми ходили в ресторан на китайську вечерю
We went out for a Chinese cuisine.
We went out for a Chinese meal.

items.pattern: junk food · eat / live on junk food · usually uncountable
items.meaning: food that is quick and tasty but bad for your health, e.g. crisps, burgers and sweets
items.example: During exam week we lived on **junk food** and coffee.
more: Supermarkets put **junk food** near the tills, where children can't miss it.
I try not to buy **junk food**, because if it's in the house, I eat it.
items.watchOut: «Шкідлива їжа» — junk food. Harmful food звучить радше як небезпечна, отруйна їжа. Fast food — страви з фастфуд-закладів (бургери, картопля фрі), а junk food ширше: ще й чипси, солодощі, печиво.

items.pattern: a nourishing meal / food / soup · similar: nutritious
items.meaning: a meal that is good for you and keeps you healthy and strong
items.example: The charity gives homeless people a hot, **nourishing meal** every evening.
more: Porridge with nuts and fruit is a cheap, **nourishing** breakfast.
Busy parents worry that their kids don't get enough **nourishing food**.
items.watchOut: «Поживний» — nourishing або nutritious. Nutrient — іменник (поживна речовина), тому a nutrient meal — помилка. Nourishing читається з /ʌ/, як у nut, а не з «ау».

items.pattern: fresh / local / farm / dairy / agricultural produce · uncountable
items.meaning: fruit, vegetables, eggs and other food from farms, sold soon after it is grown or made
items.example: The best thing about living in the countryside is the **fresh produce**: eggs from the neighbours and vegetables from the garden.
more: I buy most of my **fresh produce** on Saturdays, so it lasts until Wednesday.
The café uses **local produce**: the eggs and cheese come from the farm next door.
items.watchOut: Іменник produce має наголос на першому складі: /ˈprɒdjuːs/ (дієслово — /prəˈdjuːs/). Він незлічуваний: не produces. «Свіжі продукти» — fresh produce або fresh food; fresh products звучить як переклад. А от dairy products (молочні продукти) — звичайне сполучення, як і dairy produce.

items.pattern: organic food / vegetables / milk / farming · an organic farm
items.meaning: food grown or produced without artificial chemicals
items.example: We started buying **organic food** when our daughter was born.
more: My aunt grows **organic** tomatoes on her balcony.
**Organic** farming is better for bees and other wildlife.
items.watchOut: «Екологічно чисті продукти» — organic food. Ecological food чи eco-clean food — кальки. На упаковках у Європі буває bio, але в англійській звичайне слово — organic.

items.pattern: a ready meal · buy / heat up a ready meal · British; also a ready-made meal
items.meaning: a meal you buy already cooked, so you only need to heat it up
items.example: I got home at nine, too tired to cook, so I put a **ready meal** in the microwave.
more: Supermarkets now sell **ready meals** for one, which are handy if you live alone.
Mum never buys **ready meals**: she says she can cook better and cheaper herself.
items.watchOut: «Готові страви» з магазину — ready meals (в Америці — TV dinners). Напівфабрикати, які ще треба зварити чи підсмажити (пельмені, котлети), — convenience food; half-fabricates чи semi-products — кальки. Ready food як назва типу їжі звучить неприродно, хоча Food's ready! («Їжа готова!», «До столу!») — звичайна фраза.

items.pattern: food additives · artificial additives · additive-free
items.meaning: substances added to food to give it colour or taste or to make it last longer
items.example: I always check the label for **food additives**, especially artificial colours.
more: Fresh bread from the baker's has no **additives**, so it goes stale after a couple of days.
Some people believe certain **food additives** can cause headaches.
items.watchOut: Additives додає виробник (барвники, консерванти). Вітаміни й БАДи, які ти приймаєш сам, — supplements. Наголос на першому складі: AD-di-tives.

items.pattern: processed food(s) / meat / cheese · highly processed food
items.meaning: food that has been changed in a factory, often with added salt, sugar, fat or additives
items.example: My doctor told me to cut down on **processed food** and cook from scratch.
more: Supermarket shelves are full of **processed foods** with long lists of ingredients.
My grandparents grew up eating almost no **processed food**.
items.watchOut: «Перероблені продукти» — processed food, а не recycled: recycled кажуть про перероблені відходи (папір, пластик). Множина processed foods означає різні види такої їжі.

items.pattern: GM food(s) / crops / ingredients · genetically modified food
items.meaning: food from plants or animals whose genes have been changed by scientists
items.example: In many European countries there are strict rules on selling **GM food**.
more: The supermarket promises that none of its own-brand products contain **GM ingredients**.
Some people worry about **genetically modified food**; others say it's perfectly safe.
items.watchOut: GM — genetically modified, читається як дві літери: /ˌdʒiː ˈem/. Кажуть modified, а не modificated: такого слова немає. «ГМО» — GMOs, але про їжу частіше кажуть GM food. «Сільськогосподарські культури» — crops, а не cultures.

items.pattern: perishable food / goods · perishables (noun)
items.meaning: food that goes bad quickly, such as fish, milk or soft cheese
items.example: Put the **perishable food** in the fridge first, then unpack the rest of the shopping.
more: Shops often cut the price of **perishable goods** like bread and fish just before closing.
Fresh flowers are **perishable**, so the florist has them delivered every morning.
items.watchOut: «Швидкопсувні продукти» — perishable food (від perish — гинути). Fast-spoiling food чи quickly spoiling food — кальки. Наголос на першому складі: PER-ish-able.

items.pattern: get / have food poisoning · a case of food poisoning
items.meaning: an illness caused by eating food that has gone bad or has germs in it
items.example: My brother **got food poisoning** from a dodgy kebab and was ill for two days.
more: There were twenty cases of **food poisoning** after the school summer fair.
Reheating rice more than once can cause **food poisoning**.
items.watchOut: «Я отруївся» (їжею) — I got food poisoning або I had food poisoning. I poisoned myself звучить так, ніби ти сам випив отруту, а I was poisoned — ніби тебе хтось отруїв.

items.pattern: a light meal / lunch / breakfast / snack · opposite: a heavy / substantial meal
items.meaning: a small meal that is easy on the stomach and doesn't make you feel too full
items.example: We had a big lunch with my in-laws, so in the evening we just had a **light meal** of soup and bread.
more: The café by the river serves **light meals** like salads, omelettes and toasted sandwiches.
Before a long run, I have a **light** breakfast: a banana and some toast.
items.watchOut: «Легка їжа» — a light meal. An easy meal — страва, яку легко приготувати, а не легка для шлунка. Протилежне — a heavy meal (важка їжа) або a substantial meal (ситна).

items.pattern: a substantial meal / breakfast / lunch · similar: a big / filling meal
items.meaning: a large meal that makes you feel full
items.example: The hike takes six hours, so make sure you have a **substantial meal** before we set off.
more: The soup was nice, but it wasn't a **substantial meal**: I was hungry again by four.
Breakfast at the guest house was **substantial**: eggs, bacon, toast, fruit and yoghurt.
items.watchOut: Substantial тут означає «великий, ситний», а не «суттєвий, важливий». Significant чи essential з meal так не працюють: кажуть a substantial meal. Наголос на другому складі: sub-STAN-tial.

items.pattern: a slap-up meal / dinner · informal, British
items.meaning: a big, excellent meal, often to celebrate something
items.example: We finished painting the whole house, so we treated ourselves to a **slap-up meal** at the Italian place in town.
more: Grandad's eightieth birthday ended with a **slap-up dinner** for twenty people.
If I get the job, I'll take you out for a **slap-up meal**.
items.watchOut: Розмовне британське сполучення: найчастіше a slap-up meal / dinner (буває й lunch, feast), пишеться з дефісом. Не плутай зі slip-up — дрібна помилка, промах.

items.pattern: a gourmet meal / restaurant / food / burger
items.meaning: high-quality food, carefully cooked and often expensive
items.example: My brother-in-law is a chef, and every Christmas he cooks us a **gourmet meal**.
more: The village pub has become a **gourmet** restaurant with a three-month waiting list.
**Gourmet** sandwiches at the station cost twice as much as ordinary ones.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈɡʊəmeɪ/, t у кінці не читається. Gourmand — людина, яка дуже любить поїсти (і багато), а про вишукану їжу кажуть gourmet. «Елітна їжа» — не elite food, а gourmet food або luxury food.

items.pattern: home-cooked food / meals · home cooking · also home-made food
items.meaning: food cooked at home, not bought ready or eaten in a restaurant
items.example: Every Sunday Grandma makes a big **home-cooked** lunch for the whole family.
more: We take turns to bring a **home-cooked** dish to the office on Fridays.
Nothing beats Mum's **home cooking** on a cold evening.
items.watchOut: «Домашня їжа» — home-cooked food, home-made food або home cooking. Domestic food і house food — кальки (house wine — вино закладу, а не домашнє). Homemade особливо часто кажуть про випічку й варення: homemade cakes, homemade jam.

items.pattern: have / grab a quick snack
items.meaning: a small amount of food eaten quickly between meals
items.example: I usually have a **quick snack** at about eleven: an apple or a handful of nuts.
more: I'm meeting Jo at the station café for **a quick snack** before her train.
The museum has a little café where you can **grab a quick snack**.
items.watchOut: «Швидкий перекус» — a quick snack; a fast snack зазвичай не кажуть (хоча fast food — так). «Перекусити» — have a snack або grab a bite (to eat). Make a snack означає приготувати перекус.

items.pattern: a refreshing drink · a refreshing shower / swim · refreshingly cold
items.meaning: a drink that makes you feel cooler and less tired
items.example: The hotel welcomed us with a **refreshing drink** of orange juice and mint.
more: After the sauna, a **refreshing** glass of cold juice is just what you need.
Sparkling water with lemon is my favourite **refreshing drink** in summer.
items.watchOut: «Освіжний напій» — a refreshing drink. A fresh drink — радше «нова, ще одна порція» (Let me get you a fresh drink). Fresh juice — свіжовичавлений сік, це інше.

items.pattern: be dying of hunger · informal; also be starving · be dying for a drink / a cup of tea
items.meaning: extremely hungry (an informal exaggeration)
items.example: There was nothing to eat on the train, so by the time we arrived we were **dying of hunger**.
more: Can we stop at the next café? I'm **dying of hunger**.
I'm **dying for** a cup of tea. Shall I put the kettle on?
items.watchOut: У розмові «помираю з голоду» — I'm dying of hunger або просто I'm starving. «Голодний як вовк» дослівно не перекладають: кажуть I'm starving або I could eat a horse. Dying from hunger частіше пишуть у новинах про людей, які справді голодують.

items.pattern: a decent meal / breakfast / cup of coffee · similar: a proper meal
items.meaning: a good, satisfying meal of acceptable quality
items.example: There's nowhere to get a **decent meal** near the office, only sandwich shops.
more: Students often go home at the weekend just to get a **decent meal**.
Is there anywhere round here where you can get a **decent** cup of coffee?
items.watchOut: «Нормально поїсти» — have a decent meal або a proper meal. A normal meal — радше «звичайна їжа, як завжди». Decent тут не про ввічливість, а «добрий, як слід». Вимова: /ˈdiːsnt/, перший склад як у deep.

items.pattern: have a healthy / good / big appetite · lose your appetite · compare: an insatiable appetite
items.meaning: if you have a healthy appetite, you like your food and eat a lot of it
items.example: Our son has a **healthy appetite**: he eats everything we put in front of him.
more: You've got a **healthy appetite** today! That's your third sandwich.
A long walk by the sea always gives me a **healthy appetite**.
items.watchOut: «Приємного апетиту!» — Enjoy your meal! або Bon appétit!, а не Pleasant appetite. Healthy appetite — добра ознака. Insatiable /ɪnˈseɪʃəbl/ appetite — ненаситний апетит: людина весь час хоче ще й ніяк не наїсться.

items.pattern: a hearty breakfast / meal / soup · hearty portions · also a hearty appetite
items.meaning: a large, filling breakfast that gives you energy for the day
items.example: Dad always cooks a **hearty breakfast** on Sunday mornings: sausages, eggs, mushrooms, the lot.
more: A bowl of **hearty** vegetable soup is perfect on a winter evening.
The climbers ate a **hearty** meal and went to bed early.
items.watchOut: Hearty тут — «ситний, щедрий», а не «сердечний». Не плутай з heartfelt — щирий: heartfelt thanks, але a hearty breakfast. Вимова — як у heart, не як у heard.

items.pattern: a soft drink · soft drinks such as cola and lemonade
items.meaning: a cold drink with no alcohol in it, often sweet and fizzy
items.example: I don't drink alcohol, so at weddings I stick to **soft drinks**.
more: **Soft drinks** are much cheaper in the supermarket than at the cinema.
The machine at the station sells crisps, sweets and **soft drinks**.
items.watchOut: Soft drink — не «м'який напій», а безалкогольний: кола, лимонад, сік. Газований — fizzy: a fizzy drink. Прикметник «безалкогольний» — non-alcoholic: non-alcoholic beer. Weak drink — слабкий, розбавлений алкогольний напій.

items.pattern: spoil / ruin your appetite (for dinner) · spoil – spoilt / spoiled
items.meaning: make you not hungry for a meal because you have eaten something just before it
items.example: I had two doughnuts at the office at four, which **spoilt my appetite** for dinner.
more: The children are allowed one biscuit after school, so it doesn't **spoil their appetite**.
Don't fill up on bread before the main course. You'll **ruin your appetite**.
items.watchOut: «Перебити апетит» — spoil (або ruin) your appetite, а не break. Kill your appetite кажуть, коли щось неприємне геть відбило бажання їсти. У британській обидві форми правильні: spoilt і spoiled.

items.pattern: a set menu / lunch / meal · two or three courses at a fixed price
items.meaning: a fixed list of dishes with a few courses for one price
items.example: The **set menu** at the Italian place is three courses for twenty pounds.
more: My parents only eat out at lunchtime, when there's a cheap **set lunch**.
The **set menu** changes every week, depending on what's in season.
items.watchOut: «Комплексний обід» — a set lunch або a set menu, а не complex lunch. «Бізнес-ланч» англійською теж зазвичай set lunch: business lunch — передусім обід із діловими партнерами.

items.pattern: be reasonably priced · a reasonably priced hotel · reasonable prices
items.meaning: not too expensive; at a fair price
items.example: The little restaurant by the harbour is **reasonably priced**, and the fish is excellent.
more: We found a **reasonably priced** hotel just ten minutes from the beach.
The shop sells good-quality clothes at **reasonable prices**.
items.watchOut: Перед priced — прислівник з -ly: reasonably priced, а не reasonable priced. З іменником — прикметник: reasonable prices. Про ціни reasonable означає «помірний, прийнятний», а не «розумний».

warmup.uk: Здається, я отруївся тим салатом із креветками.
warmup.q: I think I ___ from that prawn salad.
warmup.explain: Отруїтися їжею — get food poisoning. I poisoned myself звучить так, ніби ти сам випив отруту.

warmup.uk: У цьому кафе в будні є комплексний обід.
warmup.q: This café does a ___ on weekdays.
warmup.explain: Комплексний обід — a set lunch (або set menu). Complex lunch — калька.

warmup.uk: Не давай дітям цукерки перед обідом — переб'єш їм апетит.
warmup.q: Don't give the kids sweets before lunch, or you'll ___ their appetite.
warmup.explain: Перебити апетит — spoil (або ruin) your appetite. Break тут не працює.

warmup.uk: Ми купуємо лише екологічно чисті овочі.
warmup.explain: Екологічно чисті продукти — organic food. Ecological food — калька.

warmup.uk: У мого брата завжди був добрий апетит.
warmup.q: My brother has always had a ___ appetite.
warmup.explain: Добрий апетит — a healthy (good, big) appetite. А «Приємного апетиту!» — Enjoy your meal!

warmup.uk: На дитячому святі були лише безалкогольні напої.
warmup.q: There were only ___ at the children's party.
warmup.explain: Безалкогольні напої — soft drinks. Weak drink — слабкий алкогольний напій.

warmup.uk: Я дуже скучив за домашньою їжею.
warmup.explain: Домашня їжа — home-cooked food або home cooking. Domestic food і house food — кальки.

warmup.uk: Я помираю з голоду! Коли буде вечеря?
warmup.explain: Помираю з голоду — I'm dying of hunger або I'm starving. Dying for — це «дуже хочу чогось»: I'm dying for a cup of tea.

A.q: My little brother would eat burgers and chips every day if he could. He loves ___.
A.explain: Junk food — шкідлива їжа: смачна, але некорисна.

A.q: Something I ate at the wedding gave me food ___.
A.explain: Харчове отруєння — food poisoning. Food poison — помилка.

A.q: Fish and milk are ___, so they need to go straight into the fridge.
A.explain: Perishable — швидкопсувний: такі продукти треба тримати в холоді.

B.q: We're going out for a big dinner tonight, so I'll just have a ___ lunch.
B.explain: Легкий обід — a light lunch. Не плутай з easy: an easy lunch — обід, який легко приготувати.

B.q: The waiter explained that the ___ menu had no choice: everyone got soup, fish and a dessert.
B.explain: Set menu — фіксоване меню, комплексний обід. Complex menu — калька.

B.q: The new sushi bar is surprisingly ___ priced for such a smart area.
B.explain: Перед priced потрібен прислівник: reasonably priced.

example.title: Dad's birthday lunch
example.uk:
У суботу моєму татові виповнилося шістдесят. Ніхто не хотів готувати, тож ми замовили столик у новому ресторані в місті, щоб влаштувати розкішний святковий обід.

О першій годині я вже помирав з голоду. Того ранку в мене був лише легкий сніданок: тост і кава. Брат хотів зупинитися десь і швидко перекусити, але мама сказала, що це переб'є нам апетит.

У ресторані було комплексне меню — три страви за двадцять фунтів, і це було зовсім недорого. Усе готували зі свіжих продуктів із місцевих ферм, без жодної промислово обробленої їжі. Діти пили безалкогольні напої, а тато, у якого завжди був здоровий апетит, доїв десерти за всіма.

Це був найкращий обід за останні кілька місяців.
example.en:
On Saturday it was my dad's sixtieth birthday. Nobody wanted to cook, so we booked a table at a new restaurant in town for a [[slap-up meal|b3]].

By one o'clock I was [[dying of hunger|b8]]. That morning I'd only had a [[light breakfast|b1]]: some toast and a coffee. My brother wanted to stop for a [[quick snack|b6]], but Mum said it would [[spoil our appetite|b13]].

The restaurant had a [[set menu|b14]], three courses for twenty pounds, which was very [[reasonably priced|b15]]. Everything was made from [[fresh produce|a3]] from local farms, with no [[processed food|a7]] at all. The kids had [[soft drinks|b12]], and Dad, who has always had a [[healthy appetite|b10]], finished everyone's dessert.

It was the best meal we'd had in months.
